mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wf_task (workflow_id, node_name, status, input_json, start_time) VALUES (#{workflowId}, #{nodeName}, #{status}, #{inputJson}, sysdate())
mapper.update: UPDATE wf_task SET status=#{status}, output_json=#{outputJson}, error_message=#{errorMessage}, end_time=sysdate(), duration_ms=#{durationMs} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM wf_task WHERE workflow_id = #{workflowId} ORDER BY id
